source.label: Amazon.in Fees and Pricing, NOTE 1: "All the fee types listed above are displayed excluding Goods and Services Tax (GST). We will apply 18% (eighteen percent) GST to all fees displayed above."

note: Marketplace-wide (category_id null): GST rides on every fee, not on a category. The settlement file posts it as (ItemFees, TaxOnFees) -> LineKind.FEE_TAX. The page states the rate as current and gives it no effective date, so the rule starts at the corpus coverage floor rather than at an invented one.
